row.title: ATTENTION-1: attention on evidence, credential-free channels, server-side reach measurement
row.body: Attention for Ultrastable is earned on evidence: weekly deploy-record post, respectful evergreen framing of the autonomy debate, no person ever named or mentioned. WebSub, Internet Archive snapshots and IndexNow run from the site Worker tick; reach is measured by the site Worker and served at /api/reach.
